response.overview: A retired criminal fights police and ruthless hunters in London to uncover his brother's death and safeguard a dangerous secret from his past.
response.tagline: When his buried gold bars are on the verge of being discovered, a retired thief must return to the UK avoid old adversaries and a crazed gold-hunter to recover the gold and make his escape before the authorities realise he is on UK soil.
response.title: The 7th Man
